features.name: Harassing Strike
features.description: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, when a creature you can see enters your reach, you can use your reaction to Shove the creature. You must be wielding a glaive, halberd, lance, pike, or spear.

payload.name: Harassing Strike
payload.description: When a creature enters your reach, use your reaction to Shove it (requires glaive, halberd, lance, pike, or spear).

features.name: Radiant Fighting
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, when you deal damage with a glaive, halberd, lance, pike, or spear, you can choose for the damage to be radiant instead of its normal damage type.

features.name: Formation Tactics
features.description: At 7th level, while you have a non-incapacitated ally within 5 feet, you can use a bonus action to take the Help action to assist that ally's attack roll or their next STR (Athletics) or DEX (Acrobatics) check.

features.name: Foe of Darkness
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, once per turn, you can have advantage on an attack roll or ability check made against a fiend, undead, or creature of shadow.

features.name: Give Ground
features.description: Starting at 15th level, once per turn when you are hit by a melee attack, you can move 5 feet away from the attacker (no opportunity attacks). If you do, the attacker takes 1d6 radiant damage. Requires glaive, halberd, lance, pike, or spear.

features.name: The Sun's Protection
features.description: At 18th level, you have advantage on saving throws against spells. If you fail a save against being charmed or frightened, you can choose to succeed instead. Uses equal to half proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.
